create_RLBenchDataset: create an RLBenchDataset instance to load RLBench HDF5 data with configurable data augmentation and point cloud settings
get_datum: get a single training datum dict with point clouds, gripper poses, and commands from an RLBench trial
get_gripper_pose: get the 6D gripper pose as a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix at a given trial timestep
get_commands: get position, rotation matrix, and RPY/quaternion angles for one or more end-effector keyframes
voxelize_and_get_interaction_point: voxelize a point cloud and find the closest point to a given end-effector keyframe using KDTree search
